column_description: Unique identifier for each version of the object.
ID of the object being versioned. may be NULL.
Version number of the object. may be NULL.
Details of the changes made in this version. may be NULL.
Date and time the version was created. may be NULL.
Type of version (e.g., major, minor, patch). always exactly one of 'major', 'minor', 'patch'. may be NULL.
ID of the user who created the version. may be NULL.
IP address from which the version was created. may be NULL.
User agent string of the device used to create the version. may be NULL.
